exposure: average pre-diagnosis partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PCO2)
outcome: spontaneous closure of hemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (hsPDA)
cohort: Very low birth weight (VLBW) infants born from 2006 to 2014 at the study institution, diagnosed with hemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (hsPDA) via echocardiogram in the first week of life.
finding: In VLBW infants, cesarean section, average pre-diagnosis partial pressure of carbon dioxide, and pre-diagnosis daily fluid intake were identified as factors associated with spontaneous hsPDA closure.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with spontaneous hsPDA closure in VLBW infants, though the reported OR suggests decreased odds despite the text stating increased odds.
